trips.route_note: High-speed trains run frequently from Shenzhen North or Futian station to Guangzhou South, about 30-40 minutes, then metro into the city.
trips.why: Frequent high-speed trains from Shenzhen North or Futian reach Guangzhou in 30-40 minutes, then metro into the city.
know: Trains depart frequently from Shenzhen North and Futian stations
Many museums and sights close on Mondays
Book train tickets ahead for weekends and holidays

trips.route_note: High-speed ferries run from Shekou to Jiuzhou or Hengqin, or take a coach across the Pearl River Delta via the Humen Bridge.
trips.why: The bus crosses the HZMB in about 2h34m and drops you in the city, similar timing to the train but more direct than the Guangzhou South rail route.
know: Ferries from Shekou are a scenic alternative across the Pearl River Delta
Book coach seats ahead on weekends and holidays
Best in the cooler autumn months

trips.route_note: Intercity trains and the Dongguan–Huizhou intercity line connect Shenzhen North and Futian to Dongguan stations in under an hour.
see: Opium War Museum and Humen Fort
trips.why: Intercity trains link Shenzhen North and Futian to Dongguan in under an hour, faster than the 1h15m bus.
know: Use the Dongguan-Huizhou intercity line for central stations
Fewer classic sights than Guangzhou or Zhuhai, better for a half day
